name: Wakuya (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Wakuya town emblem in grey and brown: a grey outlined ring enclosing a brown stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Wakuya, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in September 1958.

features.role: Wakuya town emblem — a grey outlined ring enclosing a brown stylised device
